description: This React component file defines TenantBootstrapGate, a wrapper component that ensures tenant bootstrap logic is executed before rendering nested routes within a protected area of a dashboard application. It imports React, React Router's Outlet for nested routing, and a TenantBootstrap component, and renders them together.

methods.name: TenantBootstrapGate()
methods.description: Functional React component that renders TenantBootstrap and Outlet to enforce bootstrap logic and nested routing.
